# ===================== Helpers: column detection & IDs ======================
# Choose scenario/total columns by CONTENT, not just names
pick_scenario_col <- function(df, candidates) {
  if (length(candidates) == 1) return(candidates)
  scores <- map_dbl(candidates, function(cn) {
    x <- as.character(df[[cn]]); x <- x[nzchar(x)]
    if (!length(x)) return(-Inf)
    frac_not_bracket <- mean(!str_starts(x, "\\["))
    frac_short       <- mean(nchar(x) <= 30)
    nunique          <- dplyr::n_distinct(x)
    frac_not_bracket + frac_short - 0.002*nunique
  })
  candidates[which.max(scores)]
}

pick_total_col <- function(df, candidates) {
  if (length(candidates) == 1) return(candidates)
  scores <- map_dbl(candidates, function(cn) {
    x <- suppressWarnings(as.numeric(as.character(df[[cn]])))
    ok <- !is.na(x); if (!any(ok)) return(-Inf)
    frac_numeric <- mean(ok)
    in_range     <- mean(x[ok] >= -0.5 & x[ok] <= 10.5)
    spread       <- sd(x[ok])
    frac_numeric + in_range + 0.05*spread
  })
  candidates[which.max(scores)]
}

find_candidates <- function(nms, kind = c("scenario","total")) {
  kind <- match.arg(kind)
  if (kind == "scenario") {
    which(str_detect(nms, regex("IOA_\\w+\\s*>>\\s*Scenario\\b", TRUE)) |
          str_detect(nms, regex("\\bScenario\\b", TRUE)))
  } else {
    which(str_detect(nms, regex("IOA_\\w+\\s*>>\\s*<strong>\\s*Total\\s*marks\\s*</strong>", TRUE)) |
          str_detect(nms, regex("IOA_\\w+\\s*>>\\s*Total\\s*marks\\b", TRUE)) |
          str_detect(nms, regex("\\bTotal\\s*marks\\b", TRUE)))
  }
}

# Stable student_id (SID > Username > Email > Alt IDs > fallback)
make_student_id <- function(df) {
  nms <- names(df)
  pick <- function(x) if (x %in% nms) as.character(df[[x]]) else NULL

  # Prefer stable institutional keys, then fall back
  id <- pick("SIS User ID") %||% pick("SID") %||% pick("Student ID") %||%
        pick("Username") %||% pick("Email") %||%
        pick("Alternative ID 1") %||% pick("Alternative ID 2")

  if (!is.null(id)) return(trimws(id))
  sprintf("row_%03d", seq_len(nrow(df)))
}

# =============================== Loader =====================================
read_one <- function(f){
  assessor <- tools::file_path_sans_ext(basename(f))
  df_raw <- read_csv(f, show_col_types = FALSE, locale = locale(encoding = "UTF-8"))
  nms <- names(df_raw)

  scen_idx  <- find_candidates(nms, "scenario")
  total_idx <- find_candidates(nms, "total")
  if (!length(scen_idx))  stop("No Scenario-like columns in: ", basename(f))
  if (!length(total_idx)) stop("No Total-like columns in: ", basename(f))

  scen_col  <- pick_scenario_col(df_raw, nms[scen_idx])
  total_col <- pick_total_col(df_raw,  nms[total_idx])

  message(sprintf("[%s] Scenario='%s' | Total='%s'", basename(f), scen_col, total_col))

  tibble(
    assessor   = assessor,
    student_id = make_student_id(df_raw),
    scenario   = df_raw[[scen_col]] |> as.character() |> str_squish(),
    total      = suppressWarnings(as.numeric(as.character(df_raw[[total_col]])))
  )
}

files <- list.files(folder, pattern="\\.(csv|CSV)$", full.names=TRUE)
stopifnot(length(files) > 0)

all <- map_dfr(files, read_one) |>
  mutate(
    assessor   = trimws(as.character(assessor)),
    student_id = trimws(as.character(student_id)),
    scenario   = trimws(as.character(scenario))
  )

# Derive pair/solo from number of assessors per student_id
pair_info <- all |>
  group_by(student_id) |>
  summarise(
    n_assessors = n_distinct(assessor[!is.na(assessor)]),
    assessors   = paste(sort(unique(assessor)), collapse = "+"),
    .groups = "drop"
  )

all <- all |>
  left_join(pair_info, by = "student_id") |>
  mutate(
    pair_mode = factor(ifelse(n_assessors >= 2, "pair", "solo"), levels = c("solo","pair")),
    pair_id   = ifelse(n_assessors >= 2, assessors, paste0("solo-", assessor)) |> factor()
  ) |>
  group_by(assessor) |>
  mutate(order_within_assessor = row_number()) |>
  ungroup()

cohort_mean <- mean(all$total, na.rm = TRUE)
cohort_sd   <- sd(all$total,   na.rm = TRUE)

kable(tibble(
  metric = c("Rows", "Assessors", "Scenarios", "Students", "Missing totals", "Cohort mean", "Cohort SD"),
  value  = c(nrow(all), n_distinct(all$assessor), n_distinct(all$scenario),
             n_distinct(all$student_id), sum(is.na(all$total)),
             round(cohort_mean,3), round(cohort_sd,3))
))

# ============================== Moderation =================================
# Ensure character keys
dat <- dat %>% mutate(assessor = trimws(as.character(assessor)),
                      scenario = trimws(as.character(scenario)))

# Light re-centred scores (within-assessor z -> cohort scale)
safe_sd <- function(x){ s <- sd(x, na.rm = TRUE); if (is.na(s) || s == 0) cohort_sd else s }

mod_rec <- dat %>%
  group_by(assessor) %>%
  mutate(a_mean = mean(total, na.rm = TRUE),
         a_sd   = safe_sd(total),
         z      = (total - a_mean)/a_sd) %>%
  ungroup() %>%
  mutate(score_moderated_recenter = z * cohort_sd + cohort_mean)

# Fixed-effects adjustment (remove assessor & scenario offsets)
ass_map <- setNames(ass_eff$effect, trimws(as.character(ass_eff$assessor)))
scn_map <- setNames(scen_eff$effect, trimws(as.character(scen_eff$scenario)))
lookup0 <- function(map, key) {
  key <- trimws(as.character(key)); v <- unname(map[key])
  if (length(v) == 0 || is.na(v)) 0 else as.numeric(v)
}

mod_fx <- mod_rec %>%
  rowwise() %>%
  mutate(
    assessor_eff = lookup0(ass_map, assessor),
    scenario_eff = lookup0(scn_map, scenario),
    score_adj_rater_scen = total - assessor_eff - scenario_eff
  ) %>%
  ungroup() %>%
  mutate(score_adj_rater_scen = score_adj_rater_scen - mean(score_adj_rater_scen, na.rm = TRUE) + cohort_mean)

mod_fx %>%
  mutate(d_recentre = score_moderated_recenter - total,
         d_fx       = score_adj_rater_scen     - total) %>%
  select(assessor, scenario, total, d_recentre, d_fx) %>%
  head(12) %>%
  kable(caption = "Sample of moderation deltas (first 12 rows)")

# ===== Settings for a 10-point scale =====
MAX_SCORE <- 10

# Grade bands by mark out of 10
grade_of_mark <- function(mark){
  cut(mark,
      breaks = c(-Inf, 5, 6.5, 7.5, 8.5, Inf),
      labels = c("Fail", "Pass", "Credit", "Distinction", "High Distinction"),
      right = FALSE, ordered_result = TRUE)
}

# 1) Assemble a long data set for raw & moderated scores (no bind_cols, selective pivot)
dist_df <- mod_fx %>%
  transmute(
    assessor,
    scenario,
    `Raw total`             = total,
    `Moderated (recenter)`  = score_moderated_recenter,
    `Moderated (FE adj)`    = score_adj_rater_scen
  ) %>%
  tidyr::pivot_longer(
    cols = c(`Raw total`, `Moderated (recenter)`, `Moderated (FE adj)`),
    names_to = "Measure",
    values_to = "score"
  ) %>%
  filter(!is.na(score)) %>%
  mutate(
    pct   = 100 * (score / MAX_SCORE),   # for % plots if you want them
    grade = grade_of_mark(score)         # grade by mark (0–10)
  )


# 2) Overall distributions ---------------------------------------------------
# Histogram + density (all measures facetted)
ggplot(dist_df, aes(pct)) +
  geom_histogram(aes(y = after_stat(density)), bins = 40, alpha = 0.4) +
  geom_density(linewidth = 0.7, na.rm = TRUE) +
  facet_wrap(~ Measure, ncol = 1, scales = "free_y") +
  labs(title = "Marks distribution (overall)",
       x = "Mark (%)", y = "Density") +
  theme_minimal(base_size = 12)

  mod_fx %>% select(assessor, student_id, scenario, total, order_within_assessor,
                    pair_mode, pair_id,
                    score_moderated_recenter, assessor_eff, scenario_eff, score_adj_rater_scen),
